title: GTA 6 Weather System Completely Re-Engineered by Rockstar
description: GTA6 Hub exclusive report: According to Eurogamer, Rockstar Games has completely re-engineered the weather system for GTA 6, adding hurricanes, rainbows, and towering clouds to achieve an unprecedented scale.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA 6 Weather System Completely Re-Engineered to Deliver Unprecedented Scale

If you thought the heavy winds and even heavier rain in Red Dead Redemption 2 looked impressive, you might be happy to learn that Rockstar Games went back and completely "re-engineered our weather system" for GTA 6. According to gaming outlet Eurogamer, the upcoming open-world epic is set to feature a drastically overhauled climate engine designed to achieve "a sense of scale we haven't felt before."

### A New Generation of Atmospheric Immersion

While previous Rockstar titles set high benchmarks for environmental interaction, the next iteration is taking a massive leap forward. The newly engineered weather mechanics introduce dynamic and visually striking elements such as severe **hurricanes**, vibrant **rainbows**, and imposing, "**vertiginous cumulonimbus clouds**."

These additions suggest a world where atmospheric conditions are not just background aesthetics, but towering, volumetric entities that command attention across the map. The vertical scale of these cumulonimbus clouds, paired with violent tropical storms and high winds, indicates a deeply immersive and reactive open world.

### Technological Evolution in Open-World Design

Building upon the impressive meteorological foundations laid by Red Dead Redemption 2, this complete overhaul of the weather system highlights Rockstar's continued commitment to environmental fidelity. While specific gameplay ramifications of these weather events remain to be detailed, the technical ambition behind the system promises a breathtaking sandbox experience for players.

## Editor's Take

Rockstar has always pushed the envelope when it comes to environmental detail in open-world games. Re-engineering the weather system from the ground up proves that they are not resting on their laurels. The addition of hurricanes and towering storm clouds points toward a living, breathing world that will likely set a new industry standard for next-generation immersion.
